items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: His wife wouldn't take my advice either. I advised her, too. I advised them both.

ctx.x: On getting married, he chose to get married.
That's right. His wife wouldn't take my advice either. I advised her, too. I advised them both. Told her why I'm speaking about him not getting

married and she didn't believe me, she thought I was jealous and I wasn't jealous at all. However, they found out. She got to the place where she would tell him that I was trying to be better than him and only trying to keep him in line to meet the public. That was my mind. Trying to keep him up to the par of the public. In dressing, appearing, and his jokes -- he used to tell jokes. He'd tell a dirty joke in front of anybody and I had to break him of that habit.
